Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Corvis wrote:
> Hi all ^_^
> just wanted to drop a quick question - if the event status is pending as "The archon is submitted to your NC for the approval.", what are approximate timeline for the approval/identifying mistakes?
> And who is NC for the case, when country doesn't have any national coordinators or princes?
> thank you in advance for your help %)
>
It takes the time to validate the Archon (which is usually less than a minute) from the NC. When there's no NC, it's up to the VEKN Chairman to approve the Archons.
Once approved, the Archon's results are integrated into the database by the next day..
